subject: Pilot Sprint Statement & Access Checklist — recap and action items
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Torres <michael@bluebaylogistics.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@bluebaylogistics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot Sprint Statement & Access Checklist — recap and action items

Hi Michael / Sarah — thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Below is a concise recap of what we heard, the proposed pilot scope, owners, and immediate access items so we can get started next week. Please reply with any corrections or confirmations.

Key pain points (as described):
- High latency for OCR-to-fulfillment pipeline during batch processing windows (3-4x slower than target).
- Inconsistent entity extraction across invoices and bills of lading, leading to manual review backlog.
- Tight cost sensitivity on per-API-call pricing due to high volume spikes.

Pilot goals (success metrics):
1) Reduce median line-item extraction latency by 40% on 95th percentile workloads (target: <450ms).
2) Improve extraction F1 by +10% on the shared prompt set for invoices and BOLs.
3) Demonstrate cost-per-doc reduction via batching/caching configuration (target: <= $0.12/doc).

Scope & timeline (proposed):
- Duration: 4-week pilot (2-week sprint + 2-week eval/rollout). Start window: week of Mar 22.
- Deliverables: prompt/eval suite (in repo), infra access for sample workload, weekly syncs, final readout with traffic profile and cost/latency breakdown.

Owners / contacts:
- Redwood: Hannah (PM / engagement lead), Vivek (Infra / access & private deployment), Aditya (CLS / evals & prompt sets).
- BlueBay: Michael (product), Sarah (data / SRE).

Immediate access & artifacts we need from BlueBay (action items):
1) Short-term sample set: 200 representative documents (anonymized) or S3 read-only path + credentials.
2) Confirm allowed network patterns for our Private deployment (VPC peering or S3 endpoint).
3) Contact for SRE ingress (name + ideal overlap windows for tests).

Attachments included: pilot-scope-v0.2.pdf (detailed scope), access-checklist.csv (fields we’ll need for credentials matrix).

Next steps (proposed):
- Michael / Sarah: confirm sample dataset availability and preferred kickoff date by EOD Wed Mar 17.
- We’ll post the meeting invite for the kickoff once we have confirmation and share the read-only S3 placeholder for transfer.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Engagement Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment(s): pilot-scope-v0.2.pdf (application/pdf), access-checklist.csv (text/csv)

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the clear summary. Quick clarifications: 

1) Data: we can provide an S3 bucket with anonymized invoices + BOLs (approx 350 docs) but need to validate the anonymization script. Can your team run a quick check against a sample set (10 files) before we transfer the whole bucket?

2) Security: our security team will need SOC 2 evidence and a short runbook describing how keys are managed for the Private deployment. Can you share a summary doc and an SRE contact for network setup?

3) Kickoff date: Mar 23 would be tight for us. We prefer Mar 29 for the kickoff to allow time for legal to review the MoA. Does that work on your side?

CC’ing Sarah since she’ll own the data handoff.

—Michael
Michael Torres
Director, Product — BlueBay Logistics

- Aditya: validate anonymization sample & confirm mapping for prompts/eval labels (24h).

- Hannah: create and share the pilot prompt/eval starter set and invite for kickoff (by Fri Mar 19).

Michael — can you confirm Sarah will upload the 10 samples and share the S3 path? Also confirm the internal SRE contact and their preferred test window (we typically do tests 10–2pm PST).

Thanks — I’ll attach a slimmed version of the scope doc after Vivek’s runbook is added.

Best,
Hannah

Hi Michael / Sarah — Vivek here (Infra). Quick notes and links so your security team can get what they need quickly:

1) SOC2 summary (redacted) attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf. It contains scope of controls, audit firm, and data handling commitments.

2) KMS & key flow: we use customer-managed keys for Private deployments. Short runbook: keys are stored in customer KMS/HSM, Redwood is granted a short-lived credential token for runtime access via STS; we rotate tokens daily and do not persist raw keys. I’ll attach a 1-page runbook to the HubSpot deal and to the DocuSign package.

3) Network options: we support VPC peering and S3 endpoint-based transfers. For a first pass I recommend S3 read-only plus signed URLs for ACL-sensitive files.

4) Proposed kickoff: Mar 29, 2027 at 10:00am PST. Please confirm and I’ll send calendar invites.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/9832
DocuSign MOA: https://www.docusign.com/link/BBL-Pilot-MOA
SOC2 summary: https://redwood.example.com/soc2-summary

If legal needs a separate redline to the MoA, please route it to legal@redwoodinference.com and we’ll prioritize.

Looking forward to kickoff.

—Vivek
